{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_float'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: any revenue value that is >= 999000.00 (to catch both '999999.99' and '999,999.99')
qa_candidates = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_float'] >= 999000.00]
print(f"Number of potential QA orders (revenue >= 999000.00): {len(qa_candidates)}")
print("Potential QA order revenue values:", qa_candidates['revenue_float'].tolist())

# Now check if any have exactly 999999.99 (with or without commas)
qa_with_comma = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
qa_with_no_comma = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']

print(f"QA orders with '999,999.99': {len(qa_with_comma)}")
print(f"QA orders with '999999.99': {len(qa_with_no_comma)}")

# Combine to get total QA orders
qa_total = len(qa_with_comma) + len(qa_with_no_comma)
print(f"Total QA orders identified: {qa_total}")

# Check mean revenue with and without QA orders
mean_with_qa = df_completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue (with QA): {mean_with_qa}")

# Remove QA orders and recalculate
df_clean = df_completed[~((df_completed['revenue'] == '999,999.99') | (df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99'))]
df_clean['revenue_float_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
mean_without_qa = df_clean['revenue_float_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue (without QA): {mean_without_qa}")"}
